whenToUse: Setting a time on mobile, as for alarms or timers.
Two or three columns are chosen together.
whenNotToUse: Desktop forms (a select or time picker is faster).
There are a great many options (rolling takes long).

alternatives.name: Time Picker
alternatives.reason: On desktop or within a form.

accessibility: Each column is a named listbox whose value changes with ↑/↓.
The middle value is announced with aria-selected and aria-activedescendant.
CSS scroll snap stops on a row when released.
Show the result as a sentence ("Your alarm rings at 7:30 AM").
